# `context` operations

The exact fields each `context.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; for an HTTP call with no token on a single-user server, the install's org on every op but `code.*` and `tracker.*` (which keep their plane's), and on [some ops](../http-api.md#request) its namespace and agent; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `context.fetch`

Read back a parked result by key: a character slice (offset/limit) or only the lines matching a regex (pattern, with context_lines).

`POST /v1/context.fetch` · MCP `loom_context_fetch` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The session or conversation the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `run_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The agent run (task scope) the call belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `blob_key` | `str` | required | The key `context.offload` returned. |
| `offset` | `int` | `0` | Character offset to start the slice at; with `pattern`, how many matches to skip. |
| `limit` | `int` | `4000` | At most this many characters of content per call (1-64000). |
| `pattern` | `str` | `''` | Regex (RE2 syntax, case-insensitive; no backreferences or lookaround). |
| `context_lines` | `int` | `0` | With `pattern`, lines of context shown around each match (0-10); context lines are numbered `lineno-` and matches `lineno:`. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when no live, unexpired blob has this key in the namespace. |
| `blob_key` | `str` | Echo of the input `blob_key`. |
| `content` | `str` | The character slice, or with `pattern` the matching lines as `lineno: text`. |
| `content_type` | `str` | Media type stored with the blob. |
| `summary` | `str` | The summary stored with the blob. |
| `total_chars` | `int` | Length of the whole stored content in characters. |
| `total_lines` | `int` | Line count of the whole stored content. |
| `offset` | `int` | Echo of the input `offset`. |
| `next_offset` | `int` | -1 when the slice (or the match list) is exhausted. |
| `matched_lines` | `int` | With `pattern`, how many lines of the whole content match; 0 otherwise. |
| `expires_at` | `datetime \| None` | When the blob stops being fetchable; None when not found. |

## `context.offload`

Park a large tool result (log, page, diff, query output) outside the model context.

`POST /v1/context.offload` · MCP `loom_context_offload` · role `writer` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The session or conversation the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `run_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The agent run (task scope) the call belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `content` | `str` | required | The text to park; larger than `LOOM_CONTEXT_OFFLOAD_MAX_BYTES` (UTF-8 bytes) is a 413. |
| `blob_key` | `str` | `''` | Empty = content-addressed (`blob/<sha256 prefix>`): parking the same output twice yields the same key and one stored row. |
| `content_type` | `str` | `'text/plain'` | Media type stored with the content and returned by `context.fetch`. |
| `summary` | `str` | `''` | Caller-provided one-liner (the tool name and what it returned). |
| `ttl_seconds` | `int` | `604800` | How long the blob stays fetchable, in seconds (1 minute to 90 days). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blob_key` | `str` | The key to fetch the content by: the one given, or `blob/<sha256 prefix>`. |
| `content_bytes` | `int` | Size of the stored content in UTF-8 bytes. |
| `content_chars` | `int` | Length of the stored content in characters. |
| `sha256` | `str` | SHA-256 hex digest of the content. |
| `summary` | `str` | The summary stored with the blob: the one given, or the content's first 200 characters. |
| `expires_at` | `datetime` | When the blob stops being fetchable. |
| `pointer` | `str` | Ready to stand in for the content in the transcript. |

## `context.pack`

A task's memories, decisions and procedures in one bundle: call it first in each task, unless a Loom hook already put Loom's context in this session.

`POST /v1/context.pack` · MCP `loom_context_pack` · role `viewer` · read

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The user the pack reads for; "-" reads every user in the memories, profile, procedures and runs sections, and the rows filed under no user in the stack and working-memory sections. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The session the pack reads for; "-" reads every session in the memories section, and the rows filed under no session in the stack and working-memory sections. |
| `run_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The agent run (task scope) the call belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `query` | `str` | `''` | Optional task/question used to select relevant memories and docs. |
| `situation` | `str` | `''` | Optional situation description used to match procedures. |
| `procedure_explore_rate` | `float \| None` | `None` | Exploration rate for the procedures section; None = 0 (never). |
| `token_budget` | `int` | `2000` | Size cap of the whole rendered pack in tokens (about 4 characters each); a longer pack is cut and `truncated` is set. |
| `top_k` | `int` | `5` | How many hits each search-backed section asks for (procedures and the stack's knowledge layer cap it at 5). |
| `read_scope` | `Literal['namespace', 'own_user', 'own_session']` | `'namespace'` | Same semantics as memory.search.read_scope; binds to this op's user_id / session_id. |
| `mode` | `Literal['startup', 'task', 'debug', 'handoff']` | `'task'` | Section budgets and search recipe, with no LLM call in any mode: `startup` (fast recall; with no query it serves pins and recent memories), `task` and `handoff` (balanced), `debug` (quality). |
| `include_knowledge` | `bool` | `False` | Add a `knowledge` section of matching document chunks; needs a `query`. |
| `include_conversations` | `bool` | `False` | Add a `conversations` section of matching past messages; needs a `query`. |
| `include_runs` | `bool` | `False` | The runs manifest — one line per recent session of this identity (date, run status and goal, tool calls by kind with errors, files touched, digest), newest first, `runs_limit` rows. |
| `runs_limit` | `int` | `12` | How many recent sessions the runs manifest lists when `include_runs` is set (1-50). |
| `include_chunks` | `bool` | `False` | Widen the memories search's reranker pool with 20 recent candidates; no effect without a reranker. |
| `section_token_budgets` | `dict[str, int]` | *(computed)* | Per-section token budgets that override the mode's defaults, keyed by section name; a section never gets fewer than 80 tokens. |
| `block_order` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Optional caller-specified block ordering. |
| `session_block` | `str` | `''` | The caller's own session bookmark (`session:<project>`, the plugin's Stop-hook note). |
| `only_sections` | `list[Literal['working_memory', 'memory_stack', 'profile', 'memories', 'procedures', 'decisions', 'knowledge', 'conversations', 'runs', 'namespace_health', 'namespace_guide', 'mentor']]` | *(computed)* | Restrict the pack to these sections. |
| `include_decisions` | `bool` | `True` | Decision-typed hits leave the memories block and render as their own tagged <decisions> section carrying the structured record (scenario, outcome, realized outcome). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rendered` | `str` | The pack as one text: each non-empty section in a `<name>` tag, in block order, cut to `token_budget`. |
| `sections` | `dict[str, str]` | Each section's body by name, in block order; sections that rendered nothing are absent. |
| `blocks` | `list[ContextBlock]` | One entry per non-empty section: label, body, token estimate, citations, source count, and `priority` (its position in block order). |
| `section_meta` | `dict[str, dict[str, Any]]` | Per-section details by name: source count, citations, whether it was cut, its size, its token budget and fill ratio (above 1.0 means it was cut). |
| `section_count` | `int` | How many sections rendered something. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | True when any section, or the whole pack, was cut to its budget. |
| `token_budget` | `int` | Echo of the input `token_budget`. |
| `mode` | `str` | Echo of the input `mode`. |
| `tokens_estimate` | `int` | Budget pressure. |
| `fill_ratio` | `float` | `tokens_estimate / token_budget`, to three places. |
| `stable_sections` | `list[str]` | The leading run of `rendered` that does not depend on `query` or `situation` — the same bytes for every question this identity asks until its working memory, profile or pins change. |
| `stable_prefix_chars` | `int` | Length in characters of that prefix of `rendered`; 0 when the first section depends on the query. |
| `stable_hash` | `str` | SHA-256 of the stable prefix; empty when `stable_prefix_chars` is 0. |
| `procedure_keys` | `list[str]` | Procedures the pack put in front of the agent: the "shown" side of the ledger a utility needs. |
| `procedure_keys_withheld` | `list[str]` | Procedures the pack matched and deliberately withheld: the "not shown" side of the same ledger. |
